clip pan envelope: no Folio record (clip gain only)
master effect parameter lanes: engine supports master keyframes; the timeline has no master row, so none are drawn (master reachable through the mixer only)

Needs a hook that edits the routing entry in the same history step as the sequence edit (Run has no combined sequence+entry submit)

run_ui_md_lines_for_lead: Multitrack (lane SMB-AU-MULTITRACK-1, feature audio-batch): Viewer::open_multitrack binds an audio source port to the timeline; audio clips then show their waveform (toolbar Waveforms hides it) and the mixer opens on the same sequence: playback and mixdown are the mixer's bus stream, rebuilt after every timeline or lane edit, undo and redo.

Click A in an audio or submix track header to open its automation lane; clicking again cycles Clip Volume / Volume / Pan / bus effect parameters / none. In Clip Volume and bus parameter lanes a click adds a point, dragging moves it, right click deletes it; each is one undo step. Volume and Pan lanes are display only (the document stores one value; edit it in the Mixer, F8).
Clip Gain -1 dB / +1 dB (toolbar) shifts the selected audio clip's volume envelope by one dB (refused if any point would leave -96..+12 dB).
